llm.summary: This classroom-coaching skill keeps teachers in control and limits saved observations, with a minor drafting-role inconsistency but no material security concern.

dimensions.detail: Access is scoped to lesson plans, class settings, pseudonymous student tiers, and learning weaknesses. No credential access, broad filesystem indexing, or external upload destination is specified.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown guidance and a data schema, with no installer, bundled executable, or remote payload execution instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The missing-draft fallback overlaps with lesson-planner's assigned role, but only generates teaching content and explicitly cannot write lessonPlans or studentTiers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Platform-backed classroom records are disclosed, limited to aggregate observations, and require teacher confirmation. Pause, sharing, export, correction, and confirmed deletion controls are provided.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Classroom questions, grouping suggestions, and aggregate observations fit the disclosed teaching purpose; teachers review student-facing content.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use student aliases, review generated teaching content and proposed records, and choose your sharing preferences. Memory and consent controls depend on the host platform implementing the documented rules.
llm.findings: [SDI-1] expected: SkillSpector's role-consistency concern is supported by the fallback wording, but drafting classroom questions remains purpose-aligned and teacher-reviewed. It does not establish unsafe autonomy or expanded mutation authority.
